art_note: Outdoor lifestyle photography establishes a strong, professional athletic aesthetic, though mixed with lower-quality mockup shots.
desc_en: Engineered to follow every movement with a relaxed, fluid silhouette. This piece balances technical functionality with a refined casual aesthetic. Designed with an adjustable elastic waistband featuring an inner drawcord and subtle side pockets. Crafted from lightweight performance fabric, it delivers uninterrupted comfort from training sessions to city streets. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Diseñado para acompañar cada movimiento con una silueta holgada y fluida. Este modelo equilibra la funcionalidad técnica con una estética relajada para el día a día. Incorpora una cintura elástica ajustable con cordón interior y bolsillos laterales discretos. Confeccionado con tejido técnico ligero, ofrece comodidad continua tanto en el entrenamiento como en entornos urbanos. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
details_en:
· Composition: 100% polyester
